race.comment: I'M A SOULMAN (2) gets the nod first-up with the inside draw, a 3kg claim and the best overall profile among the main chances. His last campaign ended with a plain eighth at Pinjarra Scarpside, but the run prior contained merit after he began awkwardly and still worked home, and he has enough 1100m substance to make a strong return. CLASSIC ROYALE (7) has the strongest York credentials, with a win and two placings from four starts at this track, and his narrow Northam second two back reads well despite a moderate last-start sixth. MERCHANT TRADER (9) has to rebound from an unwanted tenth, but his Kalgoorlie fourth two starts ago was competitive enough to keep him in the mix as the wider winning hope. CHE FIGATA (6) can feature with the blinkers coming off.
